courses.title: Financial Planning for IT Departments
courses.description: Financial Planning for IT Departments focuses on financial planning for people working toward a IT Head role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces service delivery, enough to apply alongside financial planning in real IT Head work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to financial planning and show how service delivery supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying financial planning to a real IT Head scenario
Practicing financial planning through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to service delivery
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Applying Enterprise Architecture
courses.description: Applying Enterprise Architecture is a focused course on enterprise architecture for people already working toward a IT Head role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying enterprise architecture on your own.

courses.description: Getting Started with Data Centre Operations is a short introduction to data centre operations for people moving toward a IT Head role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show data centre operations in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if data centre operations is new to you.
